name: login
description: A mobile-first wholesale order-taking web application for **LOGIN**, designed for sales representatives visiting retail mobile shops.

scripts.build:web: powershell -Command "if (Test-Path 'www') { Remove-Item -Recurse -Force 'www' }; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path 'www'; Copy-Item 'index.html', 'manifest.json', 'sw.js' -Destination 'www\'; Copy-Item -Recurse 'css', 'js', 'data', 'icons' -Destination 'www\'"
scripts.sync: npm run build:web && npx cap sync android
scripts.build:apk: npm run sync && cd android && .\gradlew.bat assembleDebug && cd ..
